facts.business: Tata Motors Ltd is India's largest commercial vehicle manufacturer offering the widest portfolio of products and services across cargo and mass mobility segments.
facts.related_party_note: All contracts/arrangements/transactions entered by the Company during FY26 with related parties were valued on an arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business and approved by the Audit Committee consisting of Independent Directors. Certain transactions, which were repetitive in nature, were approved through omnibus route.
